title: Starting a walk in available time

captions.physics: Moving together in a chosen direction
captions.emotions: Feeling the changing course of mood

meaning: Shared enjoyment becomes more available when waiting for a suitable beginning leaves room for both people’s naturally changing moods.
text: Moving towards something pleasant can be easier than allowing yourselves to begin. The Chariot in the physical position of Svadhisthana helps choose a leisure direction and coordinate your actions. The Hanged Man in energy leans towards delaying for more suitable conditions or another view of the plans. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions makes the response changeable: readiness arrives and weakens as the day proceeds. Waiting for constant enthusiasm can leave the route on a map. A free hour and agreement to try now may be sufficient for real enjoyment.

Suppose you intend to follow a river to a small garden. First you await finished tasks, then a brighter mood, and evening approaches. **Shared leisure can begin before every condition matches.** A short stretch can gradually engage you both. You may turn back earlier if desire changes and still preserve the pleasure of going out. Mood need not promise an identical intensity beforehand for the walk to have a chance.

The difficulty is explaining every postponement through an unsuitable moment, then resenting the missed time. Protecting enjoyment from interruptions leaves it an imagined ideal beginning. Changeable feeling becomes a reason to wait. Another perspective helps when it opens an available step. A modest outing offers material for a shared impression, while permission to change its length preserves freedom that endless postponement cannot provide.
